notes:
Opening a vending stall, the add stats window or your inventory was stopping the bot. While the window stayed open it would not attack, heal or do anything else, and it came back only when you closed the window. That is fixed. The bot keeps fighting and healing with any of those windows open, the way it did before 0.10.2.

Healing is also back to casting the moment it is due. A heal that was on cooldown used to be attempted anyway and quietly retried; it now waits its cooldown out and fires cleanly.

Update as usual, the app reinstalls itself cleanly.
